subtitle: Communication for Real Life

description.short: Keyboard-first AAC with adaptive prediction, emotional TTS, and AI assistant. 12 languages. Works offline.
description.full:
Prism AAC is a cross-platform Augmentative and Alternative Communication app that combines keyboard-first typing with category-based phrase navigation, adaptive word prediction, and high-quality text-to-speech with emotional tones.

Designed for individuals who benefit from AAC, their families, and clinical teams.

KEY FEATURES:

• Full keyboard with adaptive 3-tier word prediction
• 6 phrase categories organized around real routines (help, quick talk, food ordering, places, people, school)
• 9 emotional tones for text-to-speech (friendly, cheerful, calm, serious, excited, hopeful, empathetic, sad, urgent)
• AI Assistant powered by Gemini 3.1 — helps compose messages, suggests phrases, practices conversations
• Multi-step ordering flows (Chipotle, restaurant sequences)
• Math keyboard for academic work
• Contact integration — find and message people on Synalux
• 12 languages including Arabic RTL
• Works 100% offline — core communication never depends on internet
• Apple Watch / Wear OS companion — quick phrase buttons on your wrist

ACCESSIBILITY:

• 64dp minimum touch targets (exceeds WCAG 48dp standard)
• 24pt minimum font for message bar
• High-contrast mode
• Single-tap interactions only — no drag-and-drop
• Speech rate default 0.5 (slow), adjustable 0.1–1.0
• RTL layout for Arabic

SUBSCRIPTION TIERS:

• Free: System TTS, 1 language, basic predictions
• Standard ($19/mo): Azure Neural TTS, 5 tones, 3 languages, AI suggestions
• Advanced ($49/mo): All 9 tones, 12 languages, unlimited custom phrases
• Enterprise ($99/mo): Custom voice cloning, HIPAA cloud backup, team features

All paid plans include a 14-day free trial.

Prism AAC is part of the Synalux Health platform — secure clinical intelligence for pediatric and ABA practices.

Privacy: Core communication works 100% offline. Cloud features (AI, backup, contacts) require sign-in. No data is sold or shared. HIPAA-compliant on Enterprise tier.

what_is_new: Initial release: keyboard-first AAC with adaptive prediction, 9 emotional TTS tones, AI assistant (Gemini 3.1), 12 languages, contact messaging, and Apple Watch / Wear OS companion app.
